info.title: Setu UPI Issuance — TPAP API
info.description: TPAP-facing APIs for the Setu UPI Issuance switch (closed-stack PPI issuer). Phase 1: onboarding / device binding.

smsBody.description: The ready-to-send silent-SMS body. The app sends this verbatim to the VMN; the token is embedded here and is never returned separately.

vmn.description: The Virtual Mobile Number to send the SMS to.

mobile.description: The user's mobile number, with country code (e.g. 919999999999).

payeeVpa.description: The external payee VPA to block or unblock (prefix@handle; any handle).

blockedPayees.description: This page of the user's currently-blocked payee VPAs (newest-added first); empty when none.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

blockedAt.description: When the payee was most recently blocked (RFC3339).

unblockedAt.description: When the payee was unblocked (RFC3339); absent while blocked.

mobile.description: The user's mobile number, with country code (e.g. 919999999999).

programId.description: Optional program id (ULID). Validated when supplied.

vpa.description: The full VPA to check (prefix@handle, e.g. 919999999999-alice@setu). Its prefix must start with the user's mobile number.

amountLimit.description: Per-transaction cap, in paise. Omit for no cap.

code.description: The program's short code — its channel identifier.

isCreditAllowed.description: May wallets on this program receive incoming UPI? Defaults true.

isDebitAllowed.description: May wallets on this program pay outgoing UPI? Defaults true.

accountProviderId.description: The account-provider id. Optional when a TPAP default is configured.

defaultCredit.description: Make this VPA the user's default credit account.

defaultDebit.description: Make this VPA the user's default debit account.

ifsc.description: The IFSC of the account. Optional when a TPAP default is configured.

mobile.description: The user's mobile number, with country code (e.g. 919999999999).

otpRequired.description: Whether OTP verification is needed to activate the new VPA — set true for Android, false for iOS. When true, the VPA is created pending-verification until an OTP activates it; false (default) creates it active.

programId.description: Optional program id (ULID) — the program this VPA belongs to. Validated when supplied.

vpa.description: The full VPA to create (prefix@handle, e.g. 919999999999-alice@setu). Its prefix must start with the user's mobile number.

mobile.description: The user's mobile number, with country code (e.g. 919999999999).

vpa.description: The full VPA to fetch (prefix@handle, e.g. 919999999999-alice@setu). Its prefix must start with the user's mobile number.

cursor.description: The nextCursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Max entries to return this page. Omitted or non-positive defaults to 20; clamped to 100.

mobile.description: The user's mobile number, with country code (e.g. 919999999999).

isDebitAllowed.description: May wallets on this program pay outgoing UPI?

mobile.description: The user's mobile number, with country code (e.g. 919999999999).

os.description: The device OS: android or ios.

otpRequired.description: Set true for the device-change case where an OTP is needed after SIM binding (e.g. Android). Set false for iOS, or for the new-onboarding / new-VPA case where the OTP happens after VPA creation (gate it on create-vpa's otpRequired instead).
